title: Penalty awarded: challenge by Greaves on Cunha
summary: Penalty awarded: Challenge by Greaves on Cunha. Panel: The on-field call of a penalty was unanimously supported. A clear foul by Greaves on Cunha as he ran through on goal with a correct yellow card for DOGSO as it was a genuine challenge for the ball.
